package flowexperiment

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
)

// A single serial sink prevents elimination without retaining every iteration.
var e3Sink any

func e3Timing(b *testing.B, t paragraph.FlowTiming) {
	n := float64(b.N)
	b.ReportMetric(float64(t.Bind)/n, "bind-ns/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(t.Break)/n, "break-ns/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(t.Freeze)/n, "freeze-ns/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(t.Assembly)/n, "assembly-ns/op")
}

func e3Work(b *testing.B, w paragraph.FlowWork) {
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.Bound), "bound/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.BoundPrefix), "bound-prefix/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.Materialized), "materialized/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.MaterializedPrefix), "materialized-prefix/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.Search), "search/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.PrefixSearch), "search-prefix/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.BoundaryChecks), "boundary-checks/op")
	b.ReportMetric(float64(w.AssembledLines), "assembled-lines/op")
}

func e3Services(b *testing.B, before, after [7]int64, prepare, synthetic bool) {
	if !prepare {
		noBaseShaping(b, before, after)
	}
	for _, m := range []struct {
		i    int
		name string
	}{{1, "factories/op"}, {2, "shapes/op"}, {3, "acceptance/op"}} {
		b.ReportMetric(float64(after[m.i]-before[m.i])/float64(b.N), m.name)
	}
	if synthetic {
		for _, m := range []struct {
			i    int
			name string
		}{{0, "resolutions/op"}, {4, "metrics/op"}, {5, "scales/op"}, {6, "conversions/op"}} {
			b.ReportMetric(float64(after[m.i]-before[m.i])/float64(b.N), m.name)
		}
	}
}

// Cold means a fresh logical/bidi/shaping preparation each time, with preloaded
// stable font services and pre-itemized input. Disk I/O/parsing/itemization are
// outside the measurement and are never presented as measured cold-font cost.
func BenchmarkE3Prepare(b *testing.B) {
	for _, backend := range []string{"synthetic", "gentium", "hebrew"} {
		for _, words := range e3Sizes(backend) {
			b.Run(e3Name(backend, words), func(b *testing.B) {
				input, config, calls := e3Input(b, backend, words, false)
				// Preflight warms the stable face's lazy caches, not paragraph state.
				e3Sink = e3Prepare(b, input, config)
				before := calls.snapshot()
				b.ReportAllocs()
				b.ResetTimer()
				for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
					e3Sink = e3Prepare(b, input, config)
				}
				b.StopTimer()
				e3Services(b, before, calls.snapshot(), true, backend == "synthetic")
			})
		}
	}
}

// Operations include A's cut search, checkpoint creation (where needed), full
// result publication, B placement and tail validation. Relayout discards prefix
// decisions and is a cost comparator only; it must not be used as a flow oracle.
func BenchmarkE3Frames(b *testing.B) {
	for _, backend := range []string{"synthetic", "gentium", "hebrew"} {
		for _, words := range e3Sizes(backend) {
			b.Run(e3Name(backend, words), func(b *testing.B) {
				f := newE3Fixture(b, backend, words, false)
				for _, percent := range []int{10, 50, 90} {
					cut, height := f.cut(percent)
					e3Admit(b, f, cut, height)
					for _, op := range []string{"equal", "reference", "resumed", "relayout-equal", "relayout-narrow"} {
						b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("P%d/%s", percent, op), func(b *testing.B) { e3Frames(b, f, cut, height, op) })
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func e3Frames(b *testing.B, f *e3Fixture, cut int, height float64, op string) {
	var timing paragraph.FlowTiming
	ctx := paragraph.FlowTimingContext(b.Context(), &timing)
	var work paragraph.FlowWork
	before := f.calls.snapshot()
	if op == "equal" {
		f.calls.sealed.Store(true)
		defer f.calls.sealed.Store(false)
	}
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		switch op {
		case "equal":
			out, err := splitEqual(ctx, f.initial.VList, f.key, frame{f.key, height}, frame{f.key, 30000})
			if err != nil || out.status != complete || len(out.overfull) != 0 {
				b.Fatal("equal", err)
			}
			e3Sink = out
		case "reference", "resumed":
			out, err := flowToFrames(ctx, f.prepared, f.seed, height, f.key.width*3/4, 30000, op == "resumed")
			if err != nil || out.status != complete || len(out.overfull) != 0 {
				b.Fatal(op, err)
			}
			work = out.work
			e3Sink = out
		default:
			req, key := f.request, f.key
			if op == "relayout-narrow" {
				req.Params.Constraints.Width = key.width * 3 / 4
				key.width = req.Params.Constraints.Width
			}
			work = paragraph.FlowWork{}
			trace := khipu.FlowTraceContext(ctx, -1, &work.FlowWork)
			out, err := f.prepared.Layout(trace, req)
			if err != nil {
				b.Fatal(op, err)
			}
			work.AssembledLines = len(out.VList.Lines())
			split, err := splitEqual(ctx, out.VList, key, frame{key, height}, frame{key, 30000})
			if err != nil || split.status != complete || len(split.overfull) != 0 {
				b.Fatal(op, err)
			}
			e3Sink = split
		}
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	e3Timing(b, timing)
	// Baseline search is not instrumented: do not invent a zero breaker count.
	if op == "reference" || op == "resumed" || op == "equal" {
		e3Work(b, work)
	}
	b.ReportMetric(float64(cut), "accepted-lines/op")
	b.ReportMetric(100*float64(cut)/float64(len(f.initial.VList.Lines())), "accepted-percent")
	e3Services(b, before, f.calls.snapshot(), false, f.backend == "synthetic")
}

// Exactly 100 source words remain, while the prefix grows from 0 to 9,900.
// Core calls reuse a certified checkpoint; its creation is measured separately.
// Complete frame operations above include that creation in every iteration.
func BenchmarkE3FixedSuffix(b *testing.B) {
	for _, words := range []int{100, 1000, 10000} {
		b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("N%d", words), func(b *testing.B) {
			f := newE3Fixture(b, "synthetic", words, true)
			cut := (words - 100) / 10
			cp, err := f.seed.Checkpoint(b.Context(), cut)
			if err != nil {
				b.Fatal(err)
			}
			line, ok := f.initial.Frozen.Line(cut)
			if !ok || f.initial.Frozen.SourceLen()-line.Source.Start != 299 {
				b.Fatal("suffix is not exactly 100 words")
			}
			for _, op := range []string{"checkpoint", "reference", "resumed"} {
				b.Run(op, func(b *testing.B) {
					var timing paragraph.FlowTiming
					ctx := paragraph.FlowTimingContext(b.Context(), &timing)
					var work paragraph.FlowWork
					before := f.calls.snapshot()
					b.ReportAllocs()
					b.ResetTimer()
					for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
						if op == "checkpoint" {
							out, err := f.seed.Checkpoint(ctx, cut)
							if err != nil {
								b.Fatal(err)
							}
							e3Sink = out
						} else {
							out, w, err := f.prepared.FlowContinue(ctx, f.seed, cp, f.key.width*3/4, op == "resumed")
							if err != nil {
								b.Fatal(err)
							}
							work = w
							e3Sink = out
						}
					}
					b.StopTimer()
					e3Timing(b, timing)
					if op != "checkpoint" {
						e3Work(b, work)
					}
					b.ReportMetric(float64(words-100), "prefix-words/op")
					b.ReportMetric(100, "suffix-words/op")
					e3Services(b, before, f.calls.snapshot(), false, true)
				})
			}
		})
	}
}
